faqs.q: What are Eaton Aeroquip hose assemblies R2-12 and R2-16 used for?

faqs.q: How do I read Aeroquip part numbers such as R2-16-24M and R2-12-60F?
faqs.a: In the rows, the middle number is the hose dash size: -16 is a 1" hose ID and -12 is 3/4". The last number is the hose length, 24 for 24 in and 48 for 4 ft, and the letter is the end: M is MNPT × MNPT on the -16 rows, F is FJIC × FJIC on the -12 rows.

faqs.q: What end connections do the Aeroquip R2-12 and R2-16 assemblies have?
faqs.a: The R2-16 assemblies have 1" MNPT (male NPT) ends at both ends, and the R2-12 assemblies have 1-1/16" FJIC (female JIC) ends at both ends on 3/4" hose. Send us your port threads and we will confirm the match before ordering.

faqs.q: What fluids and temperatures can Aeroquip R2 hose assemblies take?
faqs.a: The maker lists petroleum and water-based fluids, including hydraulic fluid (petroleum and synthetic), diesel fuel, fuel oil, kerosene, gasoline, fresh water and ethylene glycol. Temperature is -40°F to +212°F. Tube and cover are synthetic rubber; fittings are carbon steel.

faqs.q: Which standards and approvals apply to Aeroquip R2 hose assemblies?
faqs.a: The listing names the type as a high-pressure hydraulic hose assembly and gives a 4:1 safety factor, but states no standard or approval for it. The JIC ends follow SAE J514 and the NPT ends are US taper pipe threads. Name any certificate you need with your enquiry.

faqs.q: What do Aeroquip R2 hose assemblies connect to?
